_comment: MCP model - the canonical, secret-free, VERSIONED server list of a case (technique T56). Copy it into the knowledge base, one profile per OS when commands or paths differ (e.g. mcp.windows.json, mcp.posix.json), and activate it per machine with runtime/adapters/setup-editor.ps1 (or merge-mcp-config.js). Placeholders: {KB_ROOT} and any {NAME} are resolved at activation from --var or the environment; <CONFIGURE> marks a secret that is never committed - it is filled locally, or becomes a ${input:...} prompt in VS Code. Pin package versions in your copy. The resolved activation file is machine-local and never versioned. Only the mcpServers object is read; this _comment key is ignored.
